newsitem.title: USA: M.G. Products names Eric Williams CFO.
newsitem.headline: M.G. Products names Eric Williams CFO.

text.p: M.G. Products Inc said on Monday it promoted Eric Williams to chief financial officer. He replaces Ishmael Garcia, who will remain with the company in a more strategic role.
The company also said it settled a year-old lawsuit over an alleged breach of a lease agreement for its former corporate office and distribution center in Chula Vista, Calif.
M.G. Products also said it will close its plant in Tijuana, Mexico, and transfer much of the production to its Monterrey, Mexico facility.
